name: Nieheim (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided yellow over red, with a square in counterchanged colours at the hoist of each stripe, the red square bearing the yellow cross with four roundels of the city arms of Nieheim.
history: By deed of the Regierungspräsident Detmold of 8 February 1974 the city of Nieheim was granted the right to bear arms and a flag, described as yellow and red striped lengthwise with a square in counterchanged colours at the front of each stripe.

features.role: counterchanged square at the hoist of the yellow stripe
counterchanged square at the hoist of the red stripe
cross with four roundels from the city arms
